key_points.claim: Opendoor reported a GAAP Gross Margin of -12.6 percent for 2022Q3.
Opendoor reported an Adjusted Gross Margin of 3.3 percent for 2022Q3.
The difference between the two margins is 15.9 percentage points.

prohibited_claims: The company's operations improved due to adjustments.
The negative margin indicates a loss in core operations without adjustment.
The divergence is caused by specific line items.
thesis: Opendoor reported a divergence between its GAAP Gross Margin and Adjusted Gross Margin for 2022Q3.
why_it_matters: The company reported a negative GAAP Gross Margin while reporting a positive Adjusted Gross Margin for the same period.
